correctness.rationale: The statement includes exact positive rates, leakage, single-input dynamics and all dimensions. The transfer-function partial-fraction representation and Cauchy determinant identity yield the exact Gramian determinant, including repeated rates by continuity. Boundary extension, rearrangement and first derivatives prove interior strict order. A uniform strong-damping expansion and a weak-damping compactness bound prove the two sharp limits. Log-sum-exp strict convexity gives uniqueness of the weak-damping limiting vector. The packaged pure-Python verifier reproduced 125 exact rational identities/exchanges; this is a check, not the proof of the infinite-family statement.

value.rationale: A finite network-rate budget and single upstream control create a natural but nontrivial D-optimal network-design question. Exact upstream ordering for all damping levels, two incompatible asymptotic allocation profiles and a unique all-dimension leakage-scaled vector reveal a structural rate-concentration effect. The optimal determinant scales like leakage to power -(n-1), in contrast with power -1 for any fixed positive rates. This is a substantive all-dimensional design law, although maximizing determinant alone does not ensure favorable least-eigenvalue control energy or robustness.
